The '''shadow stormtroopers''', also known as '''shadow troopers''' or '''Blackhole stormtroopers''' due to their association with Agent [[Cronal|Blackhole]], or simply just referred to as '''black-armored stormtroopers''', were a [[Special forces/Legends|specialized]] variant of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] embedded with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Overview==
Shadow stormtroopers originated from [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]].<ref name="SWTFUFP1" /><ref name="SWTFUFP2">
{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' - Figure Pack 2|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCTFUset2.asp}} {{C|as "SHADOW STORMTROOPER"}}</ref> Their most distinguishing feature was their [[Stygium armor|all-black armor]]&mdash;a stark contrast to the typical [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|white armor]] common to other stormtroopers.<ref name="LSatSoM" />

The first generation of shadow troopers wore armors laced with [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] fibers.<ref name="TFUDB">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed#The Force Unleashed Databank entries|''The Force Unleashed'' Databank]]</ref> They also had cloaking devices that allowed them to sneak up on enemies without being seen. Their armor was completely different compared to the common shadow trooper who wore the black specialized stealth armor. Their equipment consisted of [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], and a specialized built-in [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. The armor seen from these troops was painted grey and had blue glowing light panels surrounding them.<ref name="TFU" />

Later, the armor itself provided some stealth benefits, which resulted from the [[Stygian-triprismatic polymer/Legends|stygian-triprismatic polymer]] material used in the production of the armor. Lord Blackhole also incorporated [[meltmassif]] into his shadow stormtroopers for use when he would disable them.<ref name="LSatSoM" /> Shadow stormtroopers also carried [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] that rendered them invisible, or at the very least enter a state close to such, for a short period of time by warping the light around them.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> 

Shadow stormtroopers carried a variety of weaponry, from standard issue [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], [[DEMP Ion Pistol]]s, and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. Some could use [[Vibroknuckler/Legends|vibroknucklers]] to hand to hand combat. For boarding actions, breaching charges and [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutters]].

==History==
{{Quote|Answer me this: Why is the armor of my stormtroopers black?<br />I'll give you a hint: It's not just paint.|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="LSatSoM" />}}
Shadow troopers originated the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> These specialized shock units served under the command of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] aboard the research vessel ''[[Empirical]]'' and on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], and [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]<ref name="TFU360" /> and under the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard|Emperor's Shadow Guards]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and Raxus Prime.<ref name="TFUwii">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' Wii, PS2, and PSP versions</ref> They had several known encounters with [[Galen Marek]], a secret [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] trained by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

The shadow stormtroopers later acted as the personal stormtrooper unit of the head of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], [[Cronal]], better known as Agent Blackhole, which earned them their moniker of "blackhole stormtroopers." They frequently underwent special training in infiltration and ambush tactics, and were often assigned to extremely classified missions.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

[[File:Blackholestormtroopers.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Cronal's "Blackhole stormtroopers" kidnap Skywalker and Organa]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were sent on a mission to [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]], the "Gambler's [[Planet/Legends|World]]," where they were to disrupt the Imperial gambling operations with the support of the president of that world. However, the operation was disrupted by Blackhole himself, and [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of his stormtroopers were seen fighting the local resistance and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] troops.<ref name="GW" />

Cronal, now calling himself [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Shadowspawn,<ref name="Despoilers">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> led [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of shadow stormtroopers against [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces at the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. These shadow troopers' armor was made of [[meltmassif]], which allowed Shadowspawn to control them completely at will. Their ranks were primarily made up of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] and [[near-Human]] [[Hrakian]]s at this time.<ref name="SPINblog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> 

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], a squad of shadow stormtroopers<ref name="CE" /> from Blackhole's stormtrooper unit<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|blackholestormtroopers|shadow stormtroopers}}</ref> formed a bodyguard for<ref name="CE" /> aspiring [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and former member of Blackhole's stormtrooper unit<ref name="end">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> [[Carnor Jax]] during his attempt to take control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Although crack troops, they were all [[Duel in The Squall|slain]] by [[Kir Kanos]] on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]].<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Shadow_Stormtrooper.jpg|thumb|right|A shadow stormtrooper]]
Sometime between June-July [[2008]] the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] re-titled the entry from "Blackhole stormtroopers" to "shadow stormtroopers", however the original URL remained the same.<ref name="DB" />

In the [[Roleplaying game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Shadow stormtroopers were called "black hole stormtroopers" (note the space). In appearance, they were little more than standard stormtroopers with black armor. They would often be given randomly generated names, such as TK-807.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' featured stormtrooper variants identified as Shadow Troopers that visually differ from Blackhole stormtroopers. The troopers, as depicted in ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'', differ in that the trooper armor is not black in coloration but gray with blue-lit plating. Furthermore, the in-game databank identified these Shadow Troopers as possessing armor that was laced with durasteel fibers, not the stygian-triprismatic polymer material used in the production of Blackhole stormtroopers' armors.<ref name="TFU" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' eventually retconned the durasteel-armored shadow troopers from ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' as an early incarnation of the shadow stormtroopers.<ref name="TCSWE" />

[[Hasbro]] produced a shadow stormtrooper action figure for the [[2006]] San Diego Comic Convention, although it was only sold at StarWarsShop.com.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Shadow Stormtrooper (Exclusive)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSCshadowstormtrooper.asp}}</ref> The exclusive figure is referred to as a "shadow stormtrooper" on the packaging; however, the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry has the name as "Blackhole stormtrooper". Hasbro later re-released the action figure as part of the [[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|''Saga Legends'']] line.<ref name="Hasbro2">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=Saga Legends Figure|pack=Shadow Stormtrooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACSLshadowstorm.asp}}</ref>

The LEGO Group Released two Shadow Stormtrooper Minifigures in 2007 in the "[[TIE crawler/Legends|TIE Crawler]]" set. Another Shadow Stormtrooper also came with the 2008 "[[Imperial Dropship/Legends|Imperial Dropship]]," and the same toy was rereleased in 2019 to mark the twenty-year anniversary of LEGO Star Wars with updated minifigures. It also was released by the Lego Group as a limited edition maquette in partnership with Gentle Giant. According to DK's Lego Star Wars mini-figure book the Imperial Dropship set incorrectly labeled the Shadow Stormtrooper as an Imperial Pilot.
